description: This bar chart, titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” and labeled as Figure 9, displays a comparison of performance scores between two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars)—across eight academic and practical benchmarks listed along the horizontal axis: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, indicating the percentage performance on each benchmark. For each dataset, a single blue bar represents the LLaMA-3-8B-it model’s score, and an adjacent orange bar represents the score of the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each dataset, with no stacking or sorting by height. The chart’s legend, located in the top-right corner, explicitly maps the blue color to LLaMA-3-8B-it and the orange color to Ours (Iterative RLHF). Visually, the orange bars are consistently taller than the blue bars across all datasets, indicating superior performance for the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model on every benchmark shown. The chart does not include any shaded, bolded, or annotated bars for emphasis.
